review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 11, 3:20 PM ET. It had Dolphins 53% and Argonauts 47%, projecting Dolphins 1.9 – Argonauts 1.8 (3.7 total, Dolphins by 0.1).

Final: Dolphins 3 – Argonauts 2. Right winner: it had Dolphins at 53%.

review.body:
Dolphins came in with a league-average attack and a league-average defense (no scoring on file: rated at the league average), worth about 8 and 8 games of evidence. Projected to score 1.9, they scored 3 (+1.1 sets, 56% over); projected to allow 1.8, they allowed 2 (+0.2 sets, 11% over).

Argonauts came in with a 5% below average attack and a 6% leakier than average defense (no scoring on file: rated at the league average), worth about 9 and 9 games of evidence. Projected to score 1.8, they scored 2 (+0.2 sets, 11% over); projected to allow 1.9, they allowed 3 (+1.1 sets, 56% over).

The bigger miss was Dolphins' scoring (+1.1 sets against projection).

review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.277 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by -1 sets. It counts toward Volleyball scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections (it's how teams with no standings on the routes build a record of their own).

Across 164 graded Volleyball games the algo now scales scoring ×0.977 and gives home teams -0.1 sets. Team corrections so far: Argonauts attack ×0.999, defense ×0.960 (3 games).
